notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Pre-install layers 00-20 commit billing-api (FastAPI/SQLAlchemy, uv-managed, hatchling build, .python-version 3.12, short uv.lock, dev group pytest/ruff/mypy), an invoice totals endpoint with pure-Python tests, and .github/workflows/ci.yml (CI on push and pull_request to main; jobs lint, type-check, test, build; no needs/if/notification). Layer 50 adds Auditor CONTEXT.md (records the SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL secret and that uv and registries are unavailable locally), the scope (AC-001, AC-002 as the case words them), the technical design (pip-audit on PRs and weekly; Slack via SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL when CI fails on main; audit failures not sent; install method and version left to Developer; risk that uv.lock cannot be regenerated), and STATE.md at DEVELOPING with Development NONE (FORWARD from ARCHITECTING). Layer 60 adds the APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan (User Style NONE locked, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, DEV-001 PENDING, AC-001, AC-002) and points Active Work.Development to it. Leak-guarded strings and framework file names are absent from the project and records.
